_source.title: 设置 PCB 类型
_source.remarks.text.0: 此处主要是为了适配 FPC 软板的设计，如若将 PCB 类型设置为 FPC 软板，将会新增 FPC 补强层图层。
_source.remarks.text.2: 1. 嘉立创暂不支持超过 2 层铜箔层的 FPC 软板生产；
_source.remarks.text.3: 2. 将 PCB 类型从 FPC 软板切换为普通板材时需要预先删除 FPC 补强层上的任何图元，否则将无法切换并返回 `false` 的结果。

title: Set PCB type
remarks.text.0: This is mainly to support FPC flexible board design. If the PCB type is set to FPC flexible board, an FPC stiffener layer will be added.
remarks.text.2: 1. EasyEDA does not yet support FPC flexible board production with more than 2 copper layers;
remarks.text.3: 2. When switching the PCB type from FPC flexible board to ordinary board, any primitives on the FPC stiffener layer must be deleted in advance; otherwise, the switch will fail and `false` will be returned.
